name: What steps occur during the framing process before drywall can be hung?

mainEntity.name: What steps occur during the framing process before drywall can be hung?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom framing begins with a site layout, where wall placements are measured, snapped on the floor with chalk, and checked for squareness against existing walls. The crew then installs top and bottom plates, sets studs to proper spacing, and frames structural headers over doors and openings. During this stage, owner Abraham Becerra coordinates the sequence so plumbing and electrical trades can run pipes and wiring through stud bays before walls are closed. Once rough mechanicals pass any required checks, the framed structure is ready for insulation and drywall hanging.
acceptedAnswer.description: We lay out walls, construct plates and studs, set headers, coordinate plumbing and electrical rough-ins through the framing, and verify squareness before hanging drywall.
